content:
Here's a LinkedIn post for you:

---

🎉 Exciting news! I'm thrilled to announce that I've officially joined the **CDS Hooks Project Management Committee**!

Having worked with the CDS Hooks standard since 2017, this feels like a truly meaningful milestone. I've had the privilege of watching this standard grow and evolve over the years, and I couldn't be more excited to now play an active role in helping shape its future and move it forward for the healthcare community.

If you're already using CDS Hooks in your implementation, I'd love to see your work represented! Please consider adding your implementation to the community registry here 👇
🔗 https://github.com/cds-hooks/docs/wiki/CDS-Hooks-Availability

Seeing the breadth of real-world adoption is invaluable for the continued growth of the standard, and every listing helps demonstrate the impact this community is making.

And if you're **not yet using CDS Hooks** but have been curious about how it could work for your organization, now is a great time to explore it! I'm available as a **freelance consultant** to help guide your implementation — from initial planning through to deployment. Feel free to reach out and let's talk about how CDS Hooks can work for you!

Here's to the next chapter. 🚀

#CDSHooks #HealthIT #HealthcareInteroperability #FHIR #ClinicalDecisionSupport #HealthTech #Consulting
